It was released as a Starter in Japan on March 30th, 2024. It later debuted in western countries as '''Buster Dran 1-60A''' in a Starter Pack released by [[Hasbro]] for USD$9.99 in the United States. It is the successor to [[DranDagger 4-60R]] and is succeeded by [[DranBrave S6-60V]]. ==Blade - DranBuster== [[File:BladeDranBuster.png|left|150px]] {{Part|Blade - DranBuster}} ==Ratchet - 1-60== [[File:Ratchet1-60.png|left|150px]] {{Part|Ratchet - 1-60}} ==Bit - Accel== [[File:BitAccel.png|left|75px]] {{Part|Bit - Accel}} ==Releases== ===Takara Tomy=== *UX-01 Starter (blue) *UX-04 "''Special Version''" (opaque blue) - Released in the [[Battle Entry Set U]]. *UX-00 "''Metal Coat: Red''" - Released as a Booster as a [[CoroCoro Comic]] lottery prize in Japan. 100 units given away. *UX-00 "''Metal Coat: Red''" - Released as a Booster, reprint of the Metal Coat: Red release and bundled with the Japanese Special Edition release of Beyblade X manga volume 1. *UX-00 Starter "''Metal Coat: Blue FC Barcelona Version''" *UX-00 Color Choice Booster ===Hasbro=== *G1536 Starter Pack (UX-01 model; blue) ==Gallery== ===Toyline=== ====Takara Tomy==== DranBuster 1-60A Box.jpeg|DranBuster's box DranBuster 1-60A Contents.jpeg|DranBuster's UX-01 Starter contents DranBuster 1-60A (Angled View).jpg|Angled view of DranBuster Beyblade X Winder Launcher (Black×Blue Ver.).jpg|Winder Launcher (Black×Blue Version) DranBuster 1-60A Info.png|Info on DranBuster DranBuster 1-60A (Special Ver.).jpg|DranBuster 1-60A ([[Battle Entry Set U|Special Version]]) DranBuster 1-60A (Special Ver.; Angled View).jpg|Angled view of DranBuster (Special Version) DranBuster 1-60A Info (Special Ver.).png|Info on DranBuster (Special Version) DranBuster 1-60A (Metal Coat Red).jpg|DranBuster 1-60A (Metal Coat: Red) DranBuster 1-60A (Metal Coat Red; Angled View).png|Angled view of DranBuster 1-60A (Metal Coat: Red) DranBuster 1-60A (Metal Coat Red) Banner.jpg|DranBuster 1-60A (Metal Coat: Red) website banner DranBuster 1-60A (Metal Coat Blue FC Barcelona Ver.).png|DranBuster 1-60A (Metal Coat: Blue FC Barcelona Version) DranBuster 1-60A (Metal Coat Blue FC Barcelona Ver.) Learn everything about the New BEYBLADE X Unique Line!|Hasbro product overview ==Trivia== * According to the flyer included with [[Random Booster SphinxCowl Select]], the UX-01 Starter was supposed to release on March 23rd, 2024, but was delayed 1 week for unknown reasons. * The "Metal Coat: Red" release could be obtained via the May 2024 issue of the [[CoroCoro Comic]] magazine released on April 15th, 2024 in Japan. A "silver peel-off campaign" was held, with 100 winners receiving the Beyblade.[https://corocoro.jp/news/382326/ Metal Coat: Red release information] It was later rereleased together with ''Beyblade X'' manga Volume 1 Full Color Special Edition. *An officially licensed miniaturized version of this product was developed and released by American toy company Super Impulse in 2026 under their "World's Smallest" label, alongside [[HellsHammer 3-70H]] and [[WizardRod 5-70DB]]. ==References== {{Reflist}} {{Unique Line Beyblades}} [[Category:Takara Tomy]] [[Category:Hasbro]]
